definitions.prefill: Newly read tokens / native prompt seconds. Cache restore and save overhead appears in HTTP timing, not in this rate.
definitions.decode: Generated tokens / native decode seconds. Thinking tokens included when enabled.
definitions.wall: HTTP request start through final SSE DONE, including synchronous persistence before completion.
definitions.page_hit: Serialized bytes served by native hot page cache; includes repeated pages within one read. Separate from native reusable prefix tokens.
definitions.expert_hit: Native decode resident hits / expert-pool lookups; direct PCIe routes reported separately by historical metrics parser.
definitions.limits: Paired long-context repeats; natural agent trajectories can differ. No claim all coding improves by the restart speedup.
